questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: From 00:07 onwards, when the board is stationary and fully visible, exactly three pens are clearly seen arranged in a row.
All three visible pens are oriented with the black cap pointing downwards and the translucent barrel pointing upwards; they are aligned identically.
All three pens have black caps and translucent/dark barrels, appearing identical in color to one another.
All pens appear to have their caps on; no bare writing tips are exposed, and they appear to be of equal length.

The board moves from left to right initially but comes to a complete stop around 00:07 and remains frozen in the same position for the rest of the video (until 00:17), failing to move smoothly and continuously.
The pens remain fixed in their slots on the board throughout the clip; there is no relative movement between the pens and the board.

parsed.reason: The board stops moving mid-travel around the 7-second mark and remains stationary for the remainder of the video, violating the requirement for smooth, continuous motion.

description: The board stops mid-travel and stays frozen.
